subject: Demo: Redwood platform — reschedule due to budget timing
messages:
From: Joe Turner <joe.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Interest in Redwood — demo & timeline

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the intro from our internal folks. We're evaluating inference platforms for an upcoming pilot and would like a product demo covering Dedicated and Private deployment options, typical latency/cost tradeoffs, and an overview of rollouts/SLAs. Stakeholders who need to attend: me (procurement sign-off may come separately), Sarah Li (Finance), and a couple of engineers (TBD).

High-level constraints: we're in a budget planning window — Q2 spend approvals shift at the end of March for us, and a handful of leaders are traveling the last week of Feb. Ideal timing would be early March after folks are back, or mid-March after the FY budget reset.

Can you share availability for a 45-minute demo in the week of March 1–5 or March 15–19? Also any prep materials you recommend we share internally beforehand.

Thanks,
Joe
--
Joe Turner
Head of Product, Acme Corp
joe.turner@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Joe Turner <joe.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — demo & timeline

Hi Joe — great to hear from you and thanks for the timing context.

We can absolutely run a tailored 45-minute demo covering Dedicated + Private, model routing and cost controls, and a short Q&A for procurement/engineering. Proposed slots:
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Mar 3, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Tue Mar 16, 11:00–11:45 PT

Given your note about budget approvals, if the leadership team prefers to wait until after the FY budget reset we'll happily schedule for the week of Mar 16. If it helps, we can do a short 20-min pre-demo sync w/ procurement on Mar 2 to review security/compliance and procurement questions so the demo can be focused on technical fit. I've looped in Laura (solutions engineer) and Aditya (customer success) to help with the technical deep-dive and procurement prep.

Attaching: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (draft MAP), Redwood_Proposal_Q2.pdf (high-level pricing).

Let me know which slot works or if you'd like the pre-demo procurement sync — happy to set a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0143

From: Joe Turner <joe.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — demo & timeline

Hi Marissa — thanks, appreciate the options. Leadership has triggered a temporary spend freeze tied to end-of-quarter forecasting; effective immediately the buying committee is pausing major vendor evaluations until baseline budgets are confirmed. The finance team expects the freeze to lift around Mar 15 once the FY numbers are finalized.

Two asks:
1) Can we tentatively move the full demo to week of Mar 16?
2) Could we do a short 20-min procurement sync on Tue Mar 2 at 11:00 PT to walk our procurement team (procurement@acme.com) through security/compliance and contract timelines? I've attached our procurement questionnaire for your team to review ahead of the call.

If the freeze shifts earlier, we'll update you — but planning for Mar 16 for the demo is best for now.

Thanks,
Joe

Attachments: Acme_Procurement_Questions.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Joe Turner <joe.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — demo & timeline

Hi all — Laura here from Solutions Engineering. Happy to take the procurement sync on Tue Mar 2 at 11:00 PT. We'll prepare a short slide deck that covers: SOC 2 / encryption options, data residency, logging/audit capabilities, and the typical timeline for Dedicated & Private onboarding.

Marissa — I'll also include a short checklist for the procurement folks so they can fill in any gaps before the full demo (SOW/DSA/KMS questions, required compliance evidence).

Joe — for the Mar 16 demo, would you prefer an executive-level overview + technical breakout or a single session with both stakeholders? We can plan the agenda accordingly.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Joe Turner <joe.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — demo & timeline

Thanks everyone — confirmation below.

- Procurement sync: Tue Mar 2, 11:00–11:20 PT (short call with Laura + Aditya + Acme procurement). Agenda: procurement questionnaire review, evidence list, SOW timeline.
- Full demo: Tue Mar 17, 10:00–10:45 PT (tentative) — will send calendar invite once Joe confirms with leadership. Agenda: 20-min executive overview, 20-min technical demo (LAURA), 5-min Q&A.

I've uploaded the mutual action plan and proposal to our shared drive for your review: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcDEF/view?usp=sharing

Attachments: calendar_invite_procurement_sync.ics (stub), Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx, Redwood_Proposal_Q2.pdf
